name: Signature
description: Captures a signature by drawing, typing or uploading. Every mode produces the same value, a PNG data URL, and Type mode is always offered as the keyboard-accessible path.

props.name: mode
props.description: The mode shown first. Emitted as data-mode; the mode switch changes it.

props.name: modes
props.description: The modes offered, from draw, type and upload. Type is always added: it's the keyboard path.

props.name: penColor
props.description: The ink: default is the text color; the others use the color's text tone, which keeps 4.5:1 on the pad. Emitted as data-pen-color.

props.name: label
props.description: The visible label. It names the group.

props.name: hint
props.description: Help text under the pad, such as who is signing and the date. Linked with aria-describedby.

props.name: error
props.description: Validation message. Marks the field invalid and is linked with aria-describedby.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Marks the field invalid without a message. Emitted as data-invalid.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables drawing, typing, uploading and the tools. Emitted as data-disabled.

props.name: required
props.description: Marks the field required and shows the required mark.
props.a11y: Sets aria-required on the typed-name input.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: The text under the signing line. Defaults to "Sign above the line", translated.

props.name: value
props.description: The signature as a PNG data URL, or empty. Livewire binds it with wire:model, Vue with v-model.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The initial value of an uncontrolled signature.

props.name: modesLabel
props.description: The mode switch group's accessible name. Defaults to "Signature method", translated in Livewire.

props.name: drawLabel
props.description: The draw mode button. Defaults to "Draw", translated in Livewire.

props.name: typeLabel
props.description: The type mode button. Defaults to "Type", translated in Livewire.

props.name: uploadLabel
props.description: The upload mode button. Defaults to "Upload", translated in Livewire.

props.name: padLabel
props.description: The canvas's accessible name. Defaults to "Signature pad. Draw with a mouse, finger or stylus, or choose Type.", translated in Livewire.

props.name: typedLabel
props.description: The typed-name input's accessible name. Defaults to "Type your full name", translated in Livewire.

props.name: uploadTriggerLabel
props.description: The upload trigger's text. Defaults to "Choose an image", translated in Livewire.

props.name: undoLabel
props.description: The icon-only undo button's accessible name. Defaults to "Undo stroke", translated in Livewire.

props.name: clearLabel
props.description: The clear button's text. Defaults to "Clear", translated in Livewire.

props.name: clearedLabel
props.description: Announced in the live region after clearing. Defaults to "Signature cleared.", translated in Livewire.

props.name: errorField
props.description: The validation key to read from $errors. Defaults to the wire:model name.

props.name: classes
props.description: Extra classes per part, such as { pad: '…', typed: '…' }.

parts.name: root
parts.description: The field: label, mode switch, pad, hint and error. A group named by the label.

parts.name: label
parts.description: The visible label. It names the root group.

parts.name: required
parts.description: The required mark inside the label. Hidden from screen readers.

parts.name: modes
parts.description: The mode switch, a group of toggle buttons.

parts.name: mode
parts.description: One mode's toggle button, with aria-pressed.

parts.name: pad
parts.description: The bordered signing surface: the spec's frame.

parts.name: mark
parts.description: The × at the start of the line. Decorative.

parts.name: ink
parts.description: The drawing surface in draw and upload modes, an image to screen readers.

parts.name: typed
parts.description: The typed name, set on the line in a script face. Shown in type mode.

parts.name: upload
parts.description: The upload trigger wrapping a native file input. Shown in upload mode until an image is chosen.

parts.name: tools
parts.description: Undo and clear, at the pad's top end.

parts.name: undo
parts.description: Undoes the last stroke. Icon-only with an accessible name; shown in draw mode.

parts.name: placeholder
parts.description: The instruction under the line. Decorative; the pad's label says the same.

parts.name: status
parts.description: A visually hidden polite live region that announces a cleared signature.

events.name: value-change
events.description: The signature changed: a stroke ended, the name changed, an image loaded, or it was undone or cleared.

keyboard.action: Moves through the mode buttons, the typed name or the upload input, then undo and clear.
Chooses a mode or runs undo and clear.

requirements: Type mode is always offered and is the keyboard-accessible path; drawing is never the only option.
The root is a group named by the label and described by the hint and error.
The canvas is role=img with an accessible name that points to Type mode.
Mode buttons are toggle buttons with aria-pressed; switching modes starts over.
Undo and clear are labeled buttons; undo is icon-only with an accessible name, and its icon mirrors in RTL.
Clearing is announced through a polite live region.
The ink and the typed name use text tones, 4.5:1 on the pad in every theme, and CanvasText in forced colors.
Invalid shows an error edge on the pad plus the error text, never color alone.
Disabled uses --apui-surface-sunken and --apui-text-disabled, never opacity alone.
Class goes to the root; wire:model binds value; name goes to a hidden input so forms submit it.
